per-target metadata declares **CC0**; "Autogenerated ARKit faceunit").

|---|---|---|
| faceunits01.zip | d113107bd7eb59f3af4df6fc0ec29bfcc593f496d0b336aec14f086a80ce7146 | 52 ARKit-named .target files, all CC0 |
| visemes02.zip | a69ab6fb95ddd5f56f70acc7e859f5f9c6ae613c527d577ea1571eff2183d29e | 14 viseme targets (viseme_sil is zero-delta/empty, skipped by design) |

Downloaded 2026-10-10 from https://files.makehumancommunity.org/functional/
into `~/Desktop/Local/Opensource/OpenFigura-runtimes/makehuman-expressions/`
(zips stay outside git; hashes verified on every load).

Name coverage vs MediaPipe FaceLandmarker blendshape channels (real head-sculpt
run): 51/52 matched; only `_neutral` absent (not an expression). No name
mapping table needed — both sides speak ARKit.

Format: ASCII lines `vertexindex dx dy dz` against the MakeHuman hm08 base
mesh. Parser: `src/openfigura/backends/makehuman_targets.py` (thin glue,
original code; MPFB2 itself is GPLv3 and is NOT linked — we only read CC0
data files). Applying deltas to arbitrary character meshes (base-mesh
correspondence + shape-key writer) is the next step, not yet claimed.
